description: Refused a tiring-house mend, and wanted the gate to see a quiet house.
name: Augustine Phillips

description: Moved that the Master do the cutting, and that no one carry the book tonight.
name: George Bryan

description: Refused a crown taken off on his stage, and kept the afternoon struck.
name: James Burbage

description: Asked where this week was written down as allowed, and sent the house home without a second round of news.
name: John Heminges

description: Would have played the king as read, and took the leaves home under his arm.
name: Richard Burbage

description: Came from the news at the doors, heard the end, and asked where he entered.
name: Will Kemp

description: Wrote three lines and did not add a title.
name: William Shakespeare
